messages.author: /foysalemonshanto
messages.text:
I haven’t tried it yet. However, NVARC and Qwen 3.8 27B complement each other, with a correlation of 0.43 between them.NVARC is better for simple pazzle and Qwen is better for complex pazzle.


NVARC loads the Qwen3-4B model four times across separate L4 GPUs in an L4 × 4 setup. In my case, the model weights are split into four parts and loaded across the four L4 GPUs.After loading Qwen 3.8 27B, only a small amount of VRAM remains available for the KV cache. Therefore, loading Qwen3-4B alongside Qwen 3.8 27B is difficult due to the limited GPU memory.
You are using my repacked Qwen3.8 27B ha ha! thanks and carry on.
